report.headline: Most likely cause: payment-svc - database lock contention

claims.text: payment-svc database is locked for multiple orders
checkout-svc retries payment service when payment fails
payment-svc database lock errors persist for multiple orders

report.next_check: Check payment-svc database connection pool configuration and monitor database lock events
report.suggested_fix: (untested) Increase payment-svc database connection pool size
